item.title: Perryville cereal plant fined $91K, cited for 10 violations after worker's death
item.description: A Perryville, Missouri cereal plant has been fined $91,000 and cited for 10 workplace safety violations following the death of a worker inside an industrial oven last year, according to OSHA records.

item.title: Aldermen consider moratorium on detention centers
item.description: The St. Louis Board of Aldermen will consider new legislation aimed at blocking immigration detention centers in the city as deportation efforts ramp up nationwide.

item.title: Ordinance could add new cost for short-term rental operators
item.description: The city feels there’s not enough regulation in the business, while small business owners say they’re being bled dry by these bills.

item.title: Ferguson facing downward trend in crime: Mayor
item.description: Just a week after multiple people were injured during a shooting at a mortuary in Ferguson, the city's mayor, Ella Jones, is addressing the public's concerns surrounding safety.

item.title: Missouri property tax caps set for April ballots in 97 counties
item.description: A judge has cleared the way for Missouri voters in 97 counties to see a property tax cap question on their April ballots, at least for now.

item.title: Judge gives auto broker one-day sentence in drug case
item.description: A St. Charles auto broker accused of helping transport large amounts of illegal drugs for an alleged area trafficker received what a federal judge called a “deal of a lifetime."

item.title: Man fatally shot in Unincorporated North St. Louis County
item.description: Officials are investigating a fatal shooting in Unincorporated North St. Louis County that claimed the life of one person Wednesday evening.

item.title: Pavement collapse closes downtown STL street
item.description: A spokesperson for the city’s Water Division told FOX 2 that a vehicle on Spruce Street traveled over an area of weakened pavement, and a hole formed.

item.title: Family says woman's body was left in apartment more than a month
item.description: A disturbing case in St. Louis County where police say a woman’s body was left inside an apartment for weeks. Her roommate is in custody, charged with abandonment of a corpse.

item.title: The missing 6, cult ties and a new lead
item.description: Officials say there is new hope regarding the mystery following a new lead thanks to TikTok.
